name: PVC Sheeting Roll Colour Clear Blue
description: Ashmita PVC Sheeting Roll in Clear Blue is a high-definition, super clear and super genuine gloss PVC sheet designed for industrial and commercial applications. The sheet is manufactured in EN 71 grade PVC with a thickness of 0.50 mm, offering a clear blue appearance, smooth glossy finish, flexibility and durability. Available in a 54-inch width and 50-meter roll length, making it suitable for a wide range of protective, partitioning, covering and industrial applications.
shortDescription: High-definition 0.50 mm Clear Blue PVC Sheeting Roll with a super clear, glossy finish. 54-inch width and 50-meter roll length.
